checks.invariant: UE5 session cleanup should run for malformed frame type as well as normal disconnect.
checks.result: Parent ran two credentialed in-memory TestClient sessions with no lifespan or actual socket in its approved cage and promoted output. A single binary byte hex 78 raised KeyError and retained one UE5 manager entry; normal text-session disconnect retained zero. The finally cleanup added to /ws is absent from the UE5 sibling. This establishes a per-session implementation defect only; no shared outage, browser reachability, other-UID authority or security severity was established.

hardening: server.py:529-543 /ue5 still catches only WebSocketDisconnect. Parent's bounded in-memory check confirmed that a single binary frame raises KeyError and retains one manager entry; a normal disconnect retains zero. Add unconditional finally disconnect and reject unsupported frame types. This is a per-session reliability implementation defect (D7); no confirmed shared outage, cross-principal effect or security severity.

cli.py:160-179 wake --offline may spawn a child after _get('/health') swallowed a connected server error or timeout; following successful startup it POSTs an endpoint now permanently returning 403. Make explicit local wake and launch outcomes coherent and distinguish an unavailable connection from an ambiguous health probe. This is an operator workflow defect, not an established privilege boundary failure.

Process leases are intentionally process-local. Later CLI invocations cannot signal an earlier invocation's server child, so descriptions promising cross-process shutdown exceed current functionality. Keep the safe refusal or design an independently protected persistent lease ceremony; do not restore process-name selection.

tests/test_server_integration.py:47-63 still asserts a real vision registry invocation and 80-88 expects prior dry-run wording, despite current unconditional refusal. Update those expectations before treating that whole suite as a packaged-source regression gate.
